trigger_condition: set_code or collector_number containing '..' or '/' enables path traversal
guard_snippet: if '/' in collector_number or '..' in set_code: return None
potential_consequence: Writes cache file outside intended directory, potential disk write to arbitrary path

trigger_condition: cached.is_file() races with concurrent deletion before stat()
guard_snippet: try: sz = cached.stat().st_size; except FileNotFoundError: sz = 0
potential_consequence: Unhandled FileNotFoundError crashes the fetch call

trigger_condition: write_bytes fails partway (disk full, ENOSPC, permission)
guard_snippet: tmp=cached.with_suffix('.tmp'); tmp.write_bytes(...); tmp.replace(cached)
potential_consequence: Partial/corrupt cache file left, next call passes is_file+size check, returns truncated jpg

trigger_condition: cache_root/<set>/ exists as a file, not directory
guard_snippet: if cached.parent.exists() and not cached.parent.is_dir(): return None
potential_consequence: mkdir(parents=True) raises NotADirectoryError, surfaces to caller

trigger_condition: node subprocess hangs or never exits
guard_snippet: proc.communicate(input=payload, timeout=N)
potential_consequence: Parent process blocks indefinitely waiting for harness output

trigger_condition: 'node' binary not on PATH
guard_snippet: if not shutil.which('node'): raise RuntimeError('node missing')
potential_consequence: Bare FileNotFoundError from Popen with no context for user

trigger_condition: node exits non-zero with no stdout responses
guard_snippet: if proc.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError(_err)
potential_consequence: Silent harness crash returns empty dict, caller falls back without diagnostic

trigger_condition: req.slot_id is non-numeric string
guard_snippet: try: slot=int(req.slot_id); except ValueError: continue
potential_consequence: ValueError crashes whole batch before any card is rendered

trigger_condition: response dict has 'out' as non-string type (list, int)
guard_snippet: if not isinstance(out, str): continue
potential_consequence: Path(out) constructs nonsense path used downstream

trigger_condition: communicate timeout fires; process not killed
guard_snippet: except TimeoutExpired: proc.kill(); proc.communicate(); raise
potential_consequence: Zombie node process leaks after timeout, child holds stdin pipe

trigger_condition: node binary missing on PATH
guard_snippet: if shutil.which(node_bin) is None: raise RuntimeError(...)
potential_consequence: Cryptic FileNotFoundError from Popen, no actionable message

trigger_condition: node returns non-zero exit code
guard_snippet: if proc.returncode != 0: raise RuntimeError(_err)
potential_consequence: Silent harness crash treated as empty response list, every card falls back

trigger_condition: Response dict from parse_response lacks 'slot' key
guard_snippet: responses_by_slot = {r['slot']: r for r in responses if 'slot' in r}
potential_consequence: KeyError aborts entire render_deck call mid-bookkeeping

trigger_condition: Response status='ok' but 'out' key missing
guard_snippet: if 'out' not in r: fallback_rows.append(...); continue
potential_consequence: KeyError on r['out'] crashes the whole deck render

trigger_condition: harness reported 'out' path that doesn't exist on disk
guard_snippet: if not src.is_file(): fallback_rows.append(...); continue
potential_consequence: shutil.copyfile raises FileNotFoundError, batch aborts

trigger_condition: src or dst path resolve() raises (broken symlink, permission)
guard_snippet: try: same = src.resolve()==dst.resolve(); except OSError: same=False
potential_consequence: Uncaught OSError aborts render after partial work

trigger_condition: run_harness body raises TypeError unrelated to signature
guard_snippet: inspect.signature(run_harness).parameters to detect 1 vs 2-arg form
potential_consequence: Real TypeError inside callable falsely retried with 1-arg form, masking bug

trigger_condition: card name contains characters not encodable in default locale
guard_snippet: write_text(..., encoding='utf-8')
potential_consequence: UnicodeEncodeError on non-UTF8 systems writing fallback.txt

trigger_condition: name is empty string or only non-alphanumeric chars
guard_snippet: if not stripped: return 'unnamed'
potential_consequence: Slug becomes '' producing filename '0001-.png', collides across slots

trigger_condition: Two cards in deck share identical name producing same slug+slot path
guard_snippet: track seen slugs and dedupe or suffix index
potential_consequence: Not a real collision (slot differs) but expected filename pre-skip check may misfire if user renames

trigger_condition: expected path exists but is a directory not a file
guard_snippet: if expected.is_file(): ... elif expected.exists(): treat as miss
potential_consequence: Pre-existing directory at expected name causes shutil.copyfile to fail later

trigger_condition: value contains backslash on POSIX but is meant as set code
guard_snippet: only treat '\\' as path separator on win32 (os.name=='nt')
potential_consequence: POSIX user passing 'foo\\bar' set code gets misclassified as path

trigger_condition: Path(value).expanduser().resolve() on symlink loop
guard_snippet: try: p = Path(value).expanduser().resolve(strict=False); except OSError: raise FileNotFoundError(...)
potential_consequence: OSError 'too many levels of symbolic links' surfaces unwrapped

trigger_condition: value has dot in middle (e.g. 'set.code') treated as path with suffix
guard_snippet: check Path(value).suffix only against known image extensions
potential_consequence: Dotted set code misclassified as path, FileNotFoundError thrown

trigger_condition: Cached scryfall JSON file is empty or corrupted
guard_snippet: try { JSON.parse(...) } catch { unlink; refetch; }
potential_consequence: SyntaxError aborts render of every cached corrupt card permanently until manual deletion

trigger_condition: writeFileSync fails (disk full, permission)
guard_snippet: wrap fs.writeFileSync in try/catch, return scry from response body instead
potential_consequence: Disk write error propagates as fatal, no fallback to in-memory scry data

trigger_condition: job.name is undefined or non-string
guard_snippet: if (typeof job.name !== 'string') { writeResponse({status:'skip',reason:'bad name'}); return; }
potential_consequence: slugify(undefined).toLowerCase() throws TypeError, may not be cleanly caught

trigger_condition: scry.card_faces[0] or [1] is null instead of object
guard_snippet: if (scry.card_faces[i] && typeof scry.card_faces[i]==='object') ...
potential_consequence: TypeError setting .image_uris on null, kills job (caught by outer try)

trigger_condition: runNdjson() resolves while runOneJob still has unflushed stdout
guard_snippet: await new Promise(r => process.stdout.write('', r)) before exit
potential_consequence: Process exits before final response line flushed, last card response lost

trigger_condition: Job line exceeds readline buffer or contains embedded raw newline in name
guard_snippet: validate that parsed job has required fields before runOneJob
potential_consequence: Truncated/split job produces 'bad json' response with no slot context

trigger_condition: uncaughtException swallows fatal error after PNG already written
guard_snippet: log to stderr before silently swallowing
potential_consequence: Engine bug after final card produces silent failure with no diagnostic

trigger_condition: cache_root exists as a symlink to a non-directory
guard_snippet: if not cache_root.resolve().is_dir(): raise
potential_consequence: is_dir() follows symlink returning False, error message misleads user

trigger_condition: outdir contains stale PNG from a different prior deck at same slot
guard_snippet: track which slots came from current run vs. pre-existing
potential_consequence: Pre-existing PNG from unrelated prior render counted as ok for current card name

trigger_condition: Two responses returned with same slot id
guard_snippet: detect duplicate slot before dict reduction
potential_consequence: Later response silently overwrites earlier, status mismatch undetected

trigger_condition: requests.get returns HTML redirect/captcha with status 200 and large body
guard_snippet: check resp.headers['content-type'] starts with 'image/'
potential_consequence: HTML body cached as .jpg, harness later fails to decode as image
